name: wawa-smart-erp-api
description: WAWA Smart ERP - Cloudflare Workers API

scripts.deploy:production: npm run test && npm run db:check:production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrations:list:production: wrangler d1 migrations list wawa-smart-erp --env production --remote
scripts.db:check:production:
node -e "console.log('
[reminder] production deploy 전 새 migration 적용 여부 확인:
  npm run db:migrations:list:production
  npm run db:apply:production -- migrations/NNN_name.sql
')"
